Independent review of the complete main-relative three-file patch against merge base
`c2e01e6b2efe7e24585838573720911533532381`. Trusted policy pin:
`a9f3b159002c0efd3ab97967728839fae7971c8b`. The patch adds a
finite-conditioning estimate, exposes it through `Lines.lean`, and records its
limited scope for issue #464.

## Findings

<!-- findings:end -->

## Review

**Mathematical check.** `consistencyDefect_le_restrict_add_discarded_mass`
(`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/RestrictedConsistency.lean:35`) applies the
finite-support identity and inequality in `Games/RestrictedAverage.lean:21-74`.
The good samples contribute exactly their retained mass times the conditioned
average; on the complement, `PointwiseDefect.lean:28-50` bounds each defect
integrand by one. That bound follows from completeness of both measurements,
normalization of `S.psiHat`, and positivity of diagonal products on opposite
placements; it is not a caller-supplied defect assumption. The discarded
term is the entire complementary mass, with the correct coefficient and no
sign assumption on the conditioned average. Positive retained mass is needed
to define `Distribution.restrict`. `Fintype Sample` is required by the
existing `consistencyDefect` signature; `dist` need not be normalized for the
inequality, though its mass is literally a probability only for normalized
distributions. The generic estimate is not the existing concrete zero-direction
bound in `Combining/Lines/Conditioning.lean:126-166`; that older proof has a
specialized distribution, relabeling and a `1/(2q)` bound. The generic lemma
is available for later reuse, but is not yet called by the concrete proof.

**Statement integrity.** Paper `lem:qld-xz-lines` at
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:876-963`
constructs joint line POVMs and gives unconditioned average consistency over
two independent line-point samples, with a polynomial error and axis-line
degree condition. Its proof invokes one-sided pasting around lines 950-963;
it does not state this generic conditioning inequality. The new Lean theorem
assumes a projective setting, opposite placements, complete measurement
families and a positive-mass event, and concludes an ambient-defect inequality
with retained conditional defect plus discarded mass. Thus it is explicitly
**formalization-only support**, not a weakened or strengthened replacement
for the paper theorem. No paper-facing theorem statement or blueprint tag is
changed; the existing support node `lem:qld-line-conditioning-restoration`
in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1334` separately treats the
concrete application. No new bridge, residual, sentinel or default witness is
introduced. The scope brief accurately excludes the later pasting and
global-pair constructions.

**Prior reviews.** Review 5185188134 on head `91b6dad3` requested removal
of an apparently redundant `Games.RestrictedAverage` import. Review
5235612436 on head `025e6b53` noted that the line was still present but
judged it nonblocking import churn. It remains at `Lines.lean:24`, unchanged
from the current main-relative base. Because `Lines.lean` is an explicit
section-level re-export and the direct import preserves that API independent
of the new leaf's transitive imports, I do not treat its retention as a
required correction. This is an explicit disposition of the earlier F1,
not a claim that the line was deleted. Both earlier reviews and their ledgers
remain untouched. The prior reviewed patch cannot be carried: its normalized
bytes differ after `RestrictedAverage` landed on main; this is a fresh review
of the 93-added-line, three-file patch.

**Checks and limits.** Read all changed files, paper and blueprint passages,
prerequisite declarations, existing concrete caller and trusted policy/prompts.
`lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/RestrictedConsistency.lean`
exited 0 without diagnostics. A scan of the changed Lean files found no
`sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, or listed kernel bypass. `git diff --check` passed;
the detached worktree remains clean. The exact-head `local-ci/build` and all
eight per-step CI contexts plus `local-ci/summary` are green (render and
statement-origin were explicitly skipped under their selectors); the separate
rooted blueprint audit finished `DONE rc=0` with no proof-level `sorryAx`.
I did not rerun full CI or a full build and did not attempt to close the
pre-existing proof holes in `Lines.lean`. The external lean-conventions skill
was not found locally; the pinned `docs/PROOF_INTEGRITY.md`, anti-pattern and
project-local convention texts were checked instead.

VERDICT: APPROVED
